name: Kulhwch

attributes.attribute: encouraged by his father to seek help
cousin of Kulhwch and king of Camelot

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Kulhwch is a hero of Welsh or Arthurian legend. His father urged him to seek aid in winning his true love Olwen. The father told him to travel to Camelot, where his cousin Arthur sat as king. Kulhwch set out for that court to win Arthur's help.

okr.objective: Kulhwch asked King Arthur for help finding his love Olwen.
key_results: Kulhwch is a hero of Arthurian legend.
His father urged him to ask for help.
He sought his true love Olwen.
He traveled to the court of King Arthur of Camelot.
